panels.title: Energiemenge am ${tag:text} je Rasterfeld (${raster}°)
panels.description: Prognostizierte Erzeugung aus Wind und PV am gewählten Tag (Europe/Berlin) aus dem gewählten GFS-Lauf. Je Cluster: mittlere Leistung aus wind_power/pv_power mal Tageslänge, verteilt auf die 0,25°-Zellen nach Anteil an der Clusterleistung (MaStR) und auf das Raster summiert. Kreisgröße = Energiemenge, Farbe = Windanteil (gelb Sonne, blau Wind). Mouseover zeigt die Aufteilung nach Erzeugungsart. Biomasse und Wasserkraft haben keine Wetter-Leistungsprognose.

targets.rawSql:
-- Energie je Cluster auf die 0,25°-Zellen verteilen (Anteil an der Clusterleistung),
-- dann auf das gewählte Raster summieren. Biomasse und Wasserkraft haben keine
-- Leistungsprognose aus dem Wetter und fehlen daher.
WITH tag AS (
  SELECT '$tag'::date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin' AS t0,
         ('$tag'::date + 1)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin' AS t1),
e AS (
  SELECT cl.technology, cl.cluster_no,
         avg(v.value) * extract(epoch FROM tag.t1 - tag.t0) / 3600 AS mwh
    FROM feat.nwp_value v
    JOIN meta.feature f USING (feature_id)
    JOIN assets.cluster cl ON cl.region_id = v.region_id AND cl.clustering_version = '$version'
   CROSS JOIN tag
   WHERE f.source_id = (SELECT source_id FROM meta.source WHERE code = 'gfs_0p25')
     AND f.code IN ('wind_power', 'pv_power')
     AND v.run_time = '$lauf'::timestamptz
     AND v.valid_time > tag.t0 AND v.valid_time <= tag.t1
   GROUP BY 1, 2, tag.t0, tag.t1),
z AS (
  SELECT e.technology,
         floor(g.lat / $raster) * $raster + $raster / 2.0 AS lat,
         floor(g.lon / $raster) * $raster + $raster / 2.0 AS lon,
         e.mwh * g.share AS mwh
    FROM e
    JOIN assets.grid_weight g
      ON g.clustering_version = '$version' AND g.grid = 'gfs_0p25'
     AND g.technology = e.technology AND g.cluster_no = e.cluster_no)
SELECT lat, lon,
       sum(mwh) AS "Gesamt",
       sum(mwh) FILTER (WHERE technology = 'wind_on') AS "Wind an Land",
       sum(mwh) FILTER (WHERE technology = 'wind_off') AS "Wind auf See",
       sum(mwh) FILTER (WHERE technology = 'pv_ground') AS "PV Freifläche",
       sum(mwh) FILTER (WHERE technology = 'pv_roof') AS "PV Dach",
       100 * coalesce(sum(mwh) FILTER (WHERE technology LIKE 'wind%'), 0)
           / nullif(sum(mwh), 0) AS "Windanteil"
  FROM z
 GROUP BY 1, 2
HAVING sum(mwh) > 0
 ORDER BY 3

panels.title: Deutschland am ${tag:text}
panels.description: Summe der Cluster je Erzeugungsart (Wind und PV) für den gewählten Tag und GFS-Lauf.

targets.rawSql:
WITH tag AS (
  SELECT '$tag'::date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin' AS t0,
         ('$tag'::date + 1)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin' AS t1),
e AS (
  SELECT cl.technology, cl.cluster_no,
         avg(v.value) * extract(epoch FROM tag.t1 - tag.t0) / 3600 AS mwh
    FROM feat.nwp_value v
    JOIN meta.feature f USING (feature_id)
    JOIN assets.cluster cl ON cl.region_id = v.region_id AND cl.clustering_version = '$version'
   CROSS JOIN tag
   WHERE f.source_id = (SELECT source_id FROM meta.source WHERE code = 'gfs_0p25')
     AND f.code IN ('wind_power', 'pv_power')
     AND v.run_time = '$lauf'::timestamptz
     AND v.valid_time > tag.t0 AND v.valid_time <= tag.t1
   GROUP BY 1, 2, tag.t0, tag.t1)
SELECT CASE technology
  WHEN 'wind_on' THEN 'Wind an Land' WHEN 'wind_off' THEN 'Wind auf See'
  WHEN 'pv_ground' THEN 'PV Freifläche' WHEN 'pv_roof' THEN 'PV Dach'
  WHEN 'biomass' THEN 'Biomasse' WHEN 'hydro' THEN 'Wasserkraft' ELSE technology END AS "Erzeugungsart", sum(mwh) AS "Energiemenge"
  FROM e GROUP BY technology
 ORDER BY CASE technology WHEN 'wind_on' THEN 1 WHEN 'wind_off' THEN 2
                          WHEN 'pv_ground' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END

panels.title: Cluster am ${tag:text}
panels.description: Alle Cluster der Clusterung ${version} mit installierter Leistung (MaStR, rekonstruiert zum Tag) und prognostizierter Energiemenge.

targets.rawSql:
WITH tag AS (
  SELECT '$tag'::date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin' AS t0,
         ('$tag'::date + 1)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin' AS t1),
e AS (
  SELECT cl.technology, cl.cluster_no,
         avg(v.value) * extract(epoch FROM tag.t1 - tag.t0) / 3600 AS mwh
    FROM feat.nwp_value v
    JOIN meta.feature f USING (feature_id)
    JOIN assets.cluster cl ON cl.region_id = v.region_id AND cl.clustering_version = '$version'
   CROSS JOIN tag
   WHERE f.source_id = (SELECT source_id FROM meta.source WHERE code = 'gfs_0p25')
     AND f.code IN ('wind_power', 'pv_power')
     AND v.run_time = '$lauf'::timestamptz
     AND v.valid_time > tag.t0 AND v.valid_time <= tag.t1
   GROUP BY 1, 2, tag.t0, tag.t1),
cap AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (technology, cluster_no) technology, cluster_no, capacity_mw
    FROM assets.capacity_daily
   WHERE clustering_version = '$version' AND day <= '$tag'::date
   ORDER BY technology, cluster_no, day DESC)
SELECT CASE cl.technology
  WHEN 'wind_on' THEN 'Wind an Land' WHEN 'wind_off' THEN 'Wind auf See'
  WHEN 'pv_ground' THEN 'PV Freifläche' WHEN 'pv_roof' THEN 'PV Dach'
  WHEN 'biomass' THEN 'Biomasse' WHEN 'hydro' THEN 'Wasserkraft' ELSE cl.technology END AS "Erzeugungsart",
       'c' || lpad(cl.cluster_no::text, 2, '0') AS "Cluster",
       cap.capacity_mw AS "Leistung",
       e.mwh AS "Energiemenge",
       e.mwh / nullif(cap.capacity_mw, 0) AS "Volllaststunden"
  FROM assets.cluster cl
  LEFT JOIN cap USING (technology, cluster_no)
  LEFT JOIN e USING (technology, cluster_no)
 WHERE cl.clustering_version = '$version'
 ORDER BY e.mwh DESC NULLS LAST, cap.capacity_mw DESC

panels.title: Clusterung ${technologie:text} (${version})
panels.description: Leistungsgewichtetes k-Means aus mastr-ingest: Quadrate sind die 0,25°-Zellen des GFS-Gitters mit Anlagen, eingefärbt nach Cluster; Kreise sind die Clusterzentren, Größe nach installierter Leistung. Mouseover am Zentrum zeigt Leistung und die prognostizierte Energiemenge am gewählten Tag. Die Wetterfeatures werden auf genau diese Cluster gemittelt.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT lat, lon, cluster_no AS "Cluster"
  FROM assets.cluster_cell

WITH tag AS (
  SELECT '$tag'::date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin' AS t0,
         ('$tag'::date + 1)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin' AS t1),
e AS (
  SELECT cl.technology, cl.cluster_no,
         avg(v.value) * extract(epoch FROM tag.t1 - tag.t0) / 3600 AS mwh
    FROM feat.nwp_value v
    JOIN meta.feature f USING (feature_id)
    JOIN assets.cluster cl ON cl.region_id = v.region_id AND cl.clustering_version = '$version'
   CROSS JOIN tag
   WHERE f.source_id = (SELECT source_id FROM meta.source WHERE code = 'gfs_0p25')
     AND f.code IN ('wind_power', 'pv_power')
     AND v.run_time = '$lauf'::timestamptz
     AND v.valid_time > tag.t0 AND v.valid_time <= tag.t1
   GROUP BY 1, 2, tag.t0, tag.t1),
cap AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (cluster_no) cluster_no, capacity_mw
    FROM assets.capacity_daily
   WHERE clustering_version = '$version' AND technology = '$technologie'
     AND day <= '$tag'::date
   ORDER BY cluster_no, day DESC)
SELECT cl.centroid_lat AS lat, cl.centroid_lon AS lon, cl.cluster_no AS "Cluster",
       cap.capacity_mw AS "Leistung",
       e.mwh AS "Energiemenge",
       e.mwh / nullif(cap.capacity_mw, 0) AS "Volllaststunden"
  FROM assets.cluster cl
  LEFT JOIN cap USING (cluster_no)
  LEFT JOIN e ON e.technology = cl.technology AND e.cluster_no = cl.cluster_no
 WHERE cl.clustering_version = '$version' AND cl.technology = '$technologie'

panels.title: ${merkmal:text} am ${tag:text} je Cluster ${technologie:text}
panels.description: Tagesmittel des gewählten GFS-Merkmals am gewählten Tag (Europe/Berlin), leistungsgewichtet über die Zellen des Clusters gemittelt (wx-process). Auslastung und Schneeanteil in %, Niederschlag als Tagessumme.

targets.rawSql:
-- Tagesmittel des Merkmals je Cluster; Anteile in %, Niederschlag als Tagessumme
WITH tag AS (
  SELECT '$tag'::date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin' AS t0,
         ('$tag'::date + 1)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin' AS t1)
SELECT cl.centroid_lat AS lat, cl.centroid_lon AS lon, cl.cluster_no AS "Cluster",
       avg(v.value) * CASE WHEN f.code IN ('wind_cf', 'pv_cf', 'snow_fraction') THEN 100
                           WHEN f.code = 'precip' THEN extract(epoch FROM tag.t1 - tag.t0) / 3600
                           ELSE 1 END AS "Wert"
  FROM assets.cluster cl
  JOIN feat.nwp_value v ON v.region_id = cl.region_id
  JOIN meta.feature f USING (feature_id)
 CROSS JOIN tag
 WHERE cl.clustering_version = '$version' AND cl.technology = '$technologie'
   AND f.source_id = (SELECT source_id FROM meta.source WHERE code = 'gfs_0p25')
   AND f.code = '$merkmal'
   AND v.run_time = '$lauf'::timestamptz
   AND v.valid_time > tag.t0 AND v.valid_time <= tag.t1
 GROUP BY cl.centroid_lat, cl.centroid_lon, cl.cluster_no, f.code, tag.t0, tag.t1

list.name: tag
list.label: Prognosetag
list.query:
-- Tage (Europe/Berlin), die der Lauf (384 h) ganz abdeckt; der Tag des Laufs zählt mit, wenn
-- höchstens die ersten drei Stunden fehlen. "morgen" steht vorn und ist damit vorausgewählt.
WITH r AS (SELECT '$lauf'::timestamptz AS rt),
d AS (
  SELECT d::date AS d
    FROM r, generate_series(((r.rt - interval '3 hours') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin')::date,
                            ((r.rt + interval '384 hours') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin')::date,
                            interval '1 day') AS d
   WHERE d::date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin' >= r.rt - interval '3 hours'
     AND (d::date + 1)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin' <= r.rt + interval '384 hours'),
m AS (SELECT (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin')::date + 1 AS morgen)
SELECT (ARRAY['So', 'Mo', 'Di', 'Mi', 'Do', 'Fr', 'Sa'])[extract(dow FROM d)::int + 1]
       || ' ' || to_char(d, 'DD.MM.')
       || CASE d - m.morgen WHEN -1 THEN ' (heute)' WHEN 0 THEN ' (morgen)' ELSE '' END
         AS __text,
       to_char(d, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS __value
  FROM d, m
 ORDER BY d = m.morgen DESC, d
list.definition:
-- Tage (Europe/Berlin), die der Lauf (384 h) ganz abdeckt; der Tag des Laufs zählt mit, wenn
-- höchstens die ersten drei Stunden fehlen. "morgen" steht vorn und ist damit vorausgewählt.
WITH r AS (SELECT '$lauf'::timestamptz AS rt),
d AS (
  SELECT d::date AS d
    FROM r, generate_series(((r.rt - interval '3 hours') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin')::date,
                            ((r.rt + interval '384 hours') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin')::date,
                            interval '1 day') AS d
   WHERE d::date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin' >= r.rt - interval '3 hours'
     AND (d::date + 1)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin' <= r.rt + interval '384 hours'),
m AS (SELECT (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin')::date + 1 AS morgen)
SELECT (ARRAY['So', 'Mo', 'Di', 'Mi', 'Do', 'Fr', 'Sa'])[extract(dow FROM d)::int + 1]
       || ' ' || to_char(d, 'DD.MM.')
       || CASE d - m.morgen WHEN -1 THEN ' (heute)' WHEN 0 THEN ' (morgen)' ELSE '' END
         AS __text,
       to_char(d, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS __value
  FROM d, m
 ORDER BY d = m.morgen DESC, d

list.query:

  WHEN 'wind_on' THEN 'Wind an Land' WHEN 'wind_off' THEN 'Wind auf See'
  WHEN 'pv_ground' THEN 'PV Freifläche' WHEN 'pv_roof' THEN 'PV Dach'

list.name: merkmal
list.label: Wettermerkmal
list.query:
-- Merkmale, die wx-process für die Art der Technologie rechnet (config/process/gfs_0p25.yaml)
SELECT label AS __text, code AS __value
  FROM (VALUES
    ('wind', 1, 'wind_speed_hub', 'Wind in Nabenhöhe (m/s)'),
    ('wind', 2, 'wind_cf', 'Auslastung Wind (%)'),
    ('wind', 3, 'wind_power', 'Mittlere Leistung (MW)'),
    ('wind', 4, 'wind_speed_100m', 'Wind in 100 m (m/s)'),
    ('wind', 5, 'wind_speed_10m', 'Wind in 10 m (m/s)'),
    ('wind', 6, 'gust', 'Böen (m/s)'),
    ('pv', 1, 'ghi', 'Globalstrahlung (W/m²)'),
    ('pv', 2, 'pv_cf', 'Auslastung PV (%)'),
    ('pv', 3, 'pv_power', 'Mittlere Leistung (MW)'),
    ('pv', 4, 'cloud_cover', 'Bewölkung (%)'),
    ('pv', 5, 'snow_fraction', 'Schneeanteil (%)'),
    ('hydro', 1, 'precip', 'Niederschlag (mm/Tag)'),
    ('hydro', 2, 'snow_fraction', 'Schneeanteil (%)'),
    ('*', 9, 't2m', 'Temperatur in 2 m (°C)')) AS m(kind, pos, code, label)
 WHERE kind IN ('*', CASE WHEN '$technologie' LIKE 'wind%' THEN 'wind'
                          WHEN '$technologie' LIKE 'pv%' THEN 'pv'
                          WHEN '$technologie' = 'hydro' THEN 'hydro' END)
 ORDER BY pos
